output.summary: Visual direction and design system specification for U-Proof, establishing a durable, industrial-grade e-commerce interface optimized for South African contractors and DIY builders. The system prioritizes product variant clarity, accurate pricing displays, and seamless checkout confidence.
output.direction: VISION LIMITATION ACKNOWLEDGMENT: No actual visual renders, screenshots, or visual color files were provided in this job input—only text descriptions gathered from non-JavaScript fetches, project facts, and site blueprints. Therefore, the visual direction and color palette defined here represent a proposed starting design system hypothesis grounded in U-Proof's South African industrial waterproofing and building-products market context, contractor and DIY audience requirements, and existing site structure. A human designer must visually verify the live staging environment prior to final implementation. The visual direction emphasizes rugged durability, professional trust, and clear industrial utility. Layouts prioritize crisp technical typography, high-contrast action elements, prominent size/variation selectors (5L vs 20L; membrane dimensions), and explicit visual badges highlighting performance traits like elastomeric flexibility, UV resistance, and waterproofing durability.

palette.usage: Deep industrial navy for primary site header, prominent visual containers, and main brand elements (proposed starting hypothesis).
High-visibility safety amber for primary action CTAs, Add to Cart buttons, and active checkout triggers (proposed starting hypothesis).
Clean light slate background for overall site layout and content section separation.
Pure white surface for product cards, variation selectors, and application guides.
Dark slate typography for product titles, pricing text, and primary headings.
Muted slate for SKU callouts, secondary specs, unit measurements, and helper text.
Light gray border stroke for product cards, variation pills, and tab dividers.
Deep green for in-stock indicators, Fastway shipping calculation verification, and Payflex trust badges.

typography.usage: Bold, highly legible sans-serif for product names, section headings, and promotional callouts.
Standard clean sans-serif for detailed technical descriptions, coverage specifications, and step-by-step application instructions.
Monospaced font for technical specs, product codes, container measurements, and precise pricing tables.
